instructorNote: This tests the 15-minute callback rule and how downtime patient identities are tracked. Watch whether the House Supervisor calls Pediatrics and Behavioral Health right away and records their on-procedures times. Also watch whether the AOC has the command board log D-004117/D-004118 and the ZZ-Trauma aliases for HIM to match later, and confirms that blood bank specimens carry the D- number and armband.
